refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Metrics is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# Metrics APIs interface io.systemd.Metrics
# An enum representing various metric family types type MetricFamilyType( # A counter metric family type which is a monotonically increasing value counter, # A gauge metric family type which is a value that can go up and down gauge, # A string metric family type string, # An object metric family type whose value is an arbitrary JSON object object )
# Method to get a list of metrics among which the collection of related metrics forms a metric family # [Requires 'more' flag] method List() -> ( # Metric family name, e.g. io.systemd.Manager.unitsByTypeTotal or io.systemd.Manager.unitActiveState name: string, # Metric object name can be unit name, process name, etc, e.g. dev-hvc0.device object: ?string, # Metric fields are values to differentiate between different metrics in the same metric family fields: ?object, # Metric value value: any )
# Method to get the metric families # [Requires 'more' flag] method Describe() -> ( # Metric family name name: string, # Metric family description description: string, # Metric family type type: MetricFamilyType )
# No such metric found error NoSuchMetric()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Metrics shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Metrics.List '{}' invokes its List() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.Metrics interface was added in version 260.
Describe(), List(), MetricFamilyType, and NoSuchMetric were added in version 260.
